newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-BENFICA REFUSE HUGE BID FOR JOAO PINTO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BENFICA REFUSE HUGE BID FOR JOAO PINTO.

text.p: Benfica have rejected an offer from a Spanish club worth an estimated $14 million for striker Joao Vieira Pinto.
"Joao Pinto is not for sale," club vice-president Antonio Figueiredo told local radio TSF from the Netherlands where Benfica are preparing for the coming season.
Figueiredo declined to identify the Spanish side but local press reports said it was Barcelona.
Club captain Joao Pinto recently signed a "life" contract with the Lisbon club who have spent heavily over the summer on strengthening their team.
Last season was one of the worst on record for the former European champions, who finished a poor third in the league and were defeated in the Portuguese Cup final by Boavista.
"Joao Pinto is the club's crown jewel and there is no way we will let him go, particularly after making such an effort to put together a high quality team," Figueiredo said.
